next_upgrade.notes: Stable Hermes changed from v0.21.3/v2026.9.14 to v0.21.4/v2026.9.21. Official release notes describe a host-wide gateway singleton lock and Desktop rendezvous/attachment behavior, CLI --format stream-json structured JSONL output, skills.auto_load, gateway unauthorized-DM decline behavior, configurable MCP discovery concurrency, session_search bounds/recall changes, journal-mode controls, and a large set of profile/multiplex, cron, Kanban, Desktop, and state.db fixes. Full curated notes are deferred to v0.22.0, so promotion requires primary-source revalidation and deterministic gates.
